limitations: One existing snapshot and two serialized writes. The per-target async queue is separate from independent process or mixed sync/async publication. Writes publish complete snapshots through distinct temporary files and local rename, followed by best-effort cleanup and caller settlement.

Real filesystem and process cases check complete concurrent snapshots, ordered async admission, incompatible-target refusal and recovery, process termination before and after rename, and retained crash leftovers. They do not replay arbitrary model traces.

Serialization, aliases, external sibling-file mutation, filesystem failure ambiguity, cleanup refusal, permissions, caller transaction semantics and physical power loss remain separate obligations. No automatic crash-temp removal or cross-process order is promised.
